title: Learn who works on the venture

steps.do: Read the people, founder and team plan records, and list what is missing, most needed first.
Ask who the founders are, what each one does and which functions each owns, and record them.
Ask who else works on the venture, as contractor, advisor or employee, and on what terms; any agreement or grant goes to the founder.

Draft the team plan: the roles the work needs, agent or person for each from the capability register, and the human loops, as a proposed decision for the founder: only a person writes the team plan, because it sets every agent's reach.
Summarize for the strategy lead who does what, which roles are open, and why each is a person or an agent.

done_criteria.check: Does every person role in the team plan say why an agent cannot do the work, citing the capability register?
